mapping_json.fidelity_notes: Cadence's every-3rd-swing detonation FILES an accrual to the TWO-TIER-ACCUMULATOR family (counted tier on swing cadence) per m01 hot-fact -- this is the #3 attestation of the mechanism (WATCH-ITEM was fired at 2), and krieg-m02 already filed the SAME Cadence mechanism (cite as same-mechanism evidence line). Filed WITHOUT numbers (steward owns counts). Modeled in trigger_grammar as apply-consume-pair (accumulate swings -> consume on 3rd -> burst) + charge_stack accumulator economy, but the FAMILY-MINT stays a steward call -- graded un-minted. Blitz -> dash_attack. Physical = element-neutral (THE PHYSICAL RULE). Curse of Frailty RR: §2 RR-branch shape-silent -> WITHHOLD curse token (consistent with bloody-pox + m03 5x withholds). MOMENTUM_CASCADE = closest T4 to the swing-accumulator-detonation identity. CLOSE: the detonation-accumulator maps as note + accrual, not as a native engine mechanic.

mints_anchored.description: two-tier-accumulator: a build-up -> payoff grammar where an accumulator FILLS on one action-tier (combo-beat / stack / rune-slot / charge) and DISCHARGES on a second (invoke / spend / release), the two tiers being distinct mechanics rather than one magnitude scalar. The genre's dominant 'accumulate-then-unleash' pattern; the run's largest accrual mass (~10 kits, strengthening every basin). Engine accumulator scales a single magnitude; this needs a two-tier fill/discharge substrate.
